label: EU-aiact-art50-guidelines-2026 Section 8

obligations.text: In the case of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), including start-ups, each fine shall be up to the above percentages or amount, whichever is lower.
The fines shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive and take into account the interests of SMEs and small mid-cap enterprises (SMCs), including start-ups, and their economic viability.

Systems that are partly interactive and partly generative may benefit from this transitional period only with regard to the marking obligation under Article 50(2) AI Act, while compliance with the disclosure obligation for AI systems directly interacting with natural persons must be ensured as of 2 August 2026.
